title: HOPSE: Scalable Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder for Combinatorial Representations
abstract: arXiv:2505.15405v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven highly effective at modeling relational data, pairwise connections cannot fully capture multi-way relationships naturally present in complex real-world systems. In response to this, Topological Deep Learning (TDL) leverages more general combinatorial representations--such as simplicial or cellular complexes--to accommodate higher-order interactions. Existing TDL methods often extend GNNs through Higher-Order Message Passing (HOMP), but face critical scalability challenges due to the steep complexity overhead of propagating messages through combinatorial structures. translated_title: HOPSE：面向组合表示的可扩展高阶位置与结构编码器
translated_abstract: 尽管图神经网络（GNNs）已被证明在建模关系型数据方面极为有效，但成对连接无法完全捕捉复杂现实系统中天然存在的多路（multi-way）关系。为应对这一问题，拓扑深度学习（TDL）利用更通用的组合表示——如单纯复形（simplicial complexes）或胞腔复形（cellular complexes）——来容纳高阶交互。现有的拓扑深度学习方法通常通过高阶消息传递（HOMP）来扩展图神经网络，但由于在组合结构上传播消息的复杂度开销巨大，面临着严峻的可扩展性挑战。为克服这一局限，我们提出了 HOPSE（高阶位置与结构编码器），这是一个不依赖可学习消息传递层的框架，它利用 Hasse 图分解在任意高阶域上推导出高效且富有表达力的编码。值得注意的是，HOPSE 的训练和推理随输入规模呈线性扩展。
tldr: 提出 HOPSE 框架，通过摒弃可学习消息传递层、利用 Hasse 图分解，在任意高阶组合域上实现高效、可线性扩展且富有表达力的位置与结构编码，解决了高阶拓扑深度学习的可扩展性难题。
en_tdlr: HOPSE is a message-passing-free higher-order encoder that leverages Hasse graph decompositions to provide efficient, expressive positional and structural encodings over arbitrary combinatorial domains, with linearly scaling training and inference.
